governedFieldSurfaces.purpose: Closed public/internal catalog-membership vocabulary; it is not an ACL grant.
governedFieldSurfaces.rollback: Keep the closed vocabulary and persisted values; disable only new readers.

governedFieldSurfaces.rollback: Stop passing the internal projection; preserve persisted membership on existing rows.
